# sha1sum

Compute and verify SHA-1 checksums through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/sha1sum input.bin

moonx cli/sha1sum input.bin > checksums.txt
moonx cli/sha1sum -c checksums.txt
```

Hash files incrementally, or read stdin when no file is supplied or the operand is -. Verification reports each checked file.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--tag` | print BSD tagged records |
| `-c`, `--check` | read checksum records and verify files |
| `--ignore-missing` | skip missing files when checking |
| `--quiet` | suppress successful verification output |
| `--status` | suppress verification results and summaries |
| `--strict` | fail if a checksum line is malformed |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Binary/text flags select manifest markers without translating input bytes. --ignore-missing still requires a successfully checked file.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
